structure.cycles_caveat: Mapper graph cycles are not automatically equivalent to true topological loops in the data: the no-loop control produces short noise-scale graph cycles while its H1 diagram correctly shows no dominant class. Cycle length and scale context distinguish loop-like structure from noise.
